user.title: Flame Connect — unofficial
user.description: Community integration, not affiliated with or supported by Glen Dimplex. Wi-Fi cloud fireplaces only. Link through the official Microsoft page; Home Assistant never asks for your password.

data_description.policy: normal: phone/email; social: external identity provider.

link.title: Link your account
link.description:
Use the desktop linking assistant; opening this URL directly in Firefox or your usual browser is not the supported linking flow.

1. On your computer, run `node tools/link/link.mjs` from the extracted release folder. See the [installation guide]({installation_url}).
2. Copy the complete URL below and paste it into the assistant when prompted. The assistant opens a temporary Chrome, Chromium, or Edge window. Enter your credentials only in that official login window.
3. Copy the one-use msal return printed by the assistant and paste it into the protected field below.

Authorization URL — copy into the assistant, do not open directly:

```text
{authorize_url}
```

The link expires in 10 minutes. If you already opened it directly or it failed, start a new linking attempt.

data_description.callback_url: One-use msal…://auth?code=…&state=… return. Never paste your password.

devices.title: Select fireplaces
devices.description: Only Wi-Fi fireplaces are supported. Temperature values on the wire are Celsius. Automatic follows the device display preference; Home Assistant climate cards follow the installation unit system.

data_description.temperature_unit: auto, C or F; this option does not change the physical device scale.

reauth_confirm.title: Link the same Flame Connect account again
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credentials can no longer be renewed. Link the original account to preserve devices, entities and automations.

reconfigure.title: Refresh fireplace selection
reconfigure.description: Check your connection and try again.
